description:
PROVISIONAL single-judge fixture, 400 randomly sampled grimgar03 lines with unique text. NOT gold: the two-judge protocol that made attribution_gold_random.json trustworthy (94-97% concordance, pipeline scoring identically against either reader) has not been run here, and 15 of its 20 AMBIGUOUS answers are known to be artifacts of a narrower judging window since widened.

Usable for RANKING models against each other, because single-judge noise applies equally to every model scored on the same lines. NOT usable for an absolute accuracy claim.
